title: A big wish - NSClient improvement.
body:
It would be a great improvement for us parents if NS Client had 2 options:
1. Automation - the ability to remotely create, modify or disable automation in NS Client. Full synchronization with the master.
2. Quick Wizard Sync between Master and NSClient.
Our son always uses the Quick Wizard to deliver his breakfast bolus. Great feature!!! It's only annoying when we forget to enter the current amount of carbohydrates for the day in the morning when we're stressed. Subsequent QuickWizard entry in the NS-Client and synchronization with the master would be great!

Thank you for your great work, which makes life a lot easier for us parents and the children!!!

comments.body: @MilosKozak can be closed due to new master / client sync in 4.0
